headline: Nucleic acid foundation models are being tailored to specific biological constraints
label: Specialized Nucleic Acid Foundation Models
summary: Recent preprints pair sequence foundation models with task-specific design for regulatory, ncRNA, and lncRNA prediction tasks.
synthesis: The dominant thread is specialization: models are pretrained on or built for a narrow biological domain rather than reused as generic embeddings. GPN is pretrained on 455 apicomplexan assemblies and improves epigenomic prediction in Plasmodium falciparum. MARRI encodes hybridization physics directly, combining opening penalties and hybridization gains in cross-RNA attention on top of pretrained RNA representations. LncRFM supplies an open lncRNA pretraining corpus and evaluation suite and reports gains over RNA foundation models on lncRNA prediction, while B-RANKO unifies sequence generation and representation learning for ncRNA. The nitrogenase work and the coding-versus-intergenomic CNN address different sequence problems, so the shared thread is task specialization rather than a single architecture.
